heavy-haulage.name: Heavy haulage
heavy-haulage.h1: Heavy haulage: HOWO tippers, tractor units and low-beds
heavy-haulage.intro: HOWO 30 and 40 tonne tippers for earth, sand and granite, and HOWO tractor units with 40 to 120 tonne low-beds to move your plant. Hire by the day or trip, or buy new and used.

groups.name: Tipper trucks, 30t and 40t
groups.blurb: Sinotruk HOWO and Shacman 6x4 30-tonne and 8x4 40-tonne tippers.

groups.name: Tractor units with low-beds
groups.blurb: Matched tractor and low-bed combinations from 40 to 120 tonnes, with driver.

groups.name: Low-bed trailers and mobilisation
groups.blurb: Trailers on their own, and one-way trip prices to move a machine to site.

groups.name: Off-highway haulers
groups.blurb: Articulated and rigid dump trucks for quarries, mines and haul roads.

concrete.name: Concrete
concrete.h1: Concrete equipment: produce, transport and place
concrete.intro: Everything from the batching plant to the finished slab: plants and silos to produce concrete, transit mixers and cement tankers to move it, and SANY and Zoomlion pumps, booms, vibrators and trowels to place it.

groups.name: Produce
groups.blurb: Batching plants, cement silos and site mixers.

groups.name: Transport
groups.blurb: Transit mixers, bulk cement tankers and site dumpers.

groups.name: Place
groups.blurb: Boom and line pumps, placing booms, vibrators, screeds and trowels.

tools-survey.name: Tools & survey
tools-survey.h1: Small tools, site machines and survey equipment
tools-survey.intro: DJI mapping and LiDAR drones, total stations, GNSS and levels, plus the compactors, generators, pumps, power tools and hand tools every site needs.

groups.name: Drones
groups.blurb: DJI mapping, LiDAR and progress-photo drones, or a drone survey with pilot.

groups.name: Survey instruments
groups.blurb: Total stations, GNSS RTK kits and levels.

groups.name: Small machines
groups.blurb: Compactors, small generators, pumps, welding sets and drills.

groups.name: Power tools
groups.blurb: Drills, grinders, saws, cutters and welding kit.

groups.name: Hand tools and site kit
groups.blurb: Shovels to scaffold couplers, priced per piece.
